devices.US FDA Indicated Use: Indicated for embolization of hypervascular tumors in peripheral arteries ≤ 5 mm

devices.Product Name: LAVA Liquid Embolic System: LAVA 18 (2 mL, 6 mL) and LAVA 34 (2 mL, 6mL)
devices.Comments: An injectable, nonadhesive liquid embolic agent comprised of ethylene vinyl alcohol copolymer; available in two premixed product formulations with two different vial sizes offering convenient preparation, controlled delivery, and targeted occlusion for providing options for each patient’s specific treatment

devices.US FDA Indicated Use: Treating intracranial, saccular, sidewall aneurysms that present with a wide neck (≥ 4 mm) or with a dome-to-neck ratio < 2 mm that are not amenable to treatment with surgical clipping
devices.Comments: High-viscosity formulation liquid embolic for the treatment of intracranial wide-necked aneurysms that are not amenable to treatment with surgical clipping

devices.Product Name: Onyx Liquid Embolic System: Onyx 18 and Onyx 34
devices.Comments: An ethylene vinyl alcohol copolymer that provides controlled injection and reliability for presurgical embolization of brain AVMs

devices.Materials Used: Trufill n-BCA, Trufill ethiodized oil, and tantalum powder; these components must be used as a system
devices.US FDA Indicated Use: Embolization of cerebral AVMs when presurgical devascularization is desired; premarket approval device
devices.Comments: A clear, free-flowing liquid, which polymerizes quickly on contact with body fluid or tissue; it offers convenient preparation and delivery, customized radiopacity for visualization, and effective penetration of AVMs
